_help: Quiz for Fish the Dead Projects. 5 to 8 questions. answer must match one of the options exactly. explain is shown after the quiz. This folder is never shown to visitors.

questions.question: What is a rug pull?
options: When the team takes the money and disappears
When a token price goes up fast
A new kind of wallet
When a chain upgrades
questions.answer: When the team takes the money and disappears
questions.explain: In a rug pull the people behind a project drain the funds or sell everything and vanish.

questions.question: Which sign suggests a project may be dying?
options: The team stops updating and the community goes quiet
The website is updated every week
The code keeps getting new releases
More people use the app every month
questions.answer: The team stops updating and the community goes quiet
questions.explain: Abandoned projects often keep a token trading long after the work has stopped.

questions.question: Why do many tokens end up close to zero?
options: Most projects fail, like most startups
Every token always comes back
Prices are fixed by law
Only scams ever fail
questions.answer: Most projects fail, like most startups
questions.explain: Failure is normal. That is why you never put in more than you can afford to lose.

questions.question: An algorithmic stablecoin loses its dollar peg. What can happen?
options: It can collapse, as Terra's UST did in 2022
Nothing, stablecoins cannot fall
The bank refunds everyone
It always comes back within a day
questions.answer: It can collapse, as Terra's UST did in 2022
questions.explain: Some stablecoins are only stable while people trust them.

questions.question: What is a good habit before buying a token?
options: Check whether the product is used and the team is still building
Buy it because the price is rising
Trust the most excited posts
Buy it because it is cheap per token
questions.answer: Check whether the product is used and the team is still building
questions.explain: Real use and active builders matter more than hype.

questions.question: Which of these is the safest lesson from dead projects?
options: Spread your risk and only use money you can afford to lose
Put everything into one coin
Borrow money to buy more
Never sell, no matter what
questions.answer: Spread your risk and only use money you can afford to lose
questions.explain: Even good projects can die. Keep each bet small.
